_meta.prompt_text: Create a Python function called shortest_path(edges, start, end) that returns the shortest total distance and a list of nodes along the path (distance, path). edges is a list of tuples (from_node, to_node, weight) representing one-way streets. If start and end are the same node, return (0, [start]). If the weight of any edge is negative, raise a ValueError. If the route does not exist, return (None, None). (Example: edges=[("A","B",1), ("B","C",2), ("A","C",5)], start="A", end="C" -> (3, ["A", "B", "C"]))
